Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter

Dear Ms. Trivedi,

Thank you for meeting us on 3 October 2020 about your dispute with Nandini Dalvi. As we understand it, the landlord needs the premises for the family's own use.

Our advice is to plead bona fide personal need with proof of the family's housing requirement. Please collect proof of the family's housing requirement and the property tax records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of 4.5 lakh rupees.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
